parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the Prometheus instance. Valid values: aliyun-cs and ecs.

parameters.name: IntegrationType
parameters.description: The integration type. Valid values: kafka, mysql, redis, snmp, emr, nubela, and tidb.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms get-prometheus-integration --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --integration-type tidb --instance-id 2800 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms GetPrometheusIntegration --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterId cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --InstanceId 2800 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --IntegrationType tidb
